newsitem.title: DUBAI: Abu Dhabi to invest $3 bln in oil projects by 2000.
newsitem.headline: Abu Dhabi to invest $3 bln in oil projects by 2000.

text.p: Abu Dhabi National Oil Company (ADNOC) plans to invest $3 billion in new petroleum projects by the end of the decade, ADNOC general manager Yousef Omair Bin Yousef was quoted as saying by the London-based Arabic language Al-Hayat newspaper on Sunday.
The projects would be "carried out in cooperation with several international oil firms including Exxon, Mobil, British Petroleum and Total SA," Al-Hayat reported.
ADNOC's investments would centre on developing the emirate's refining capacity, developing oil wells and expanding gas liquefaction facilities, Al-Hayat reported Bin Yousef as saying.
ADNOC is currently drawing up plans to expand its Ruwais oil refinery and expand oil and gas handling capacity at its onshore and offshore fields.
Foreign oil firms already have stakes in ADNOC's oil and gas operations.
ADNOC is the main operating oil firm in OPEC-member UAE.
